retrievalProfile.description: Produces raw, flash-lit indoor portraits featuring youth subculture aesthetics with a distinct 90s film grain and flat, direct lighting.

recipe.visualDefinition: A candid, flash-lit indoor scene featuring three young adults in grunge-inspired attire. The central figure is a seated male with bleached hair, flanked by two standing females whose heads are partially cropped. The lighting is flat and direct, characteristic of a point-and-shoot camera, creating harsh shadows against a plain, off-white wall.
coreVisualRelationships: Central seated figure as the primary focal point
Symmetrical flanking by standing figures creating a vertical frame
Direct flash lighting creating high contrast against the background
coreInvariants: Visible film grain and slight color shift toward warm/yellow tones
Direct, non-diffused flash causing flat facial features and hard shadows
90s/early 2000s DIY fashion elements like tank tops, lace, and chokers

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main subject is seated centrally in a white plastic chair, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame. The standing figures are cropped at the neck/chest level.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bleached hair of the central figure and the white plastic chair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central face, move upward to the cropped figures, and then down to the hands and lap area.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the subjects fill the frame against a flat wall and curtain.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Faded denim blue and skin tones
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast due to flash; shadows are deep black while highlights are blown out.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 35mm film-style photograph of three young adults in a dimly lit room. Use a harsh direct flash. The central male has bleached blonde hair and wears a white tank top, seated in a white plastic chair. Two females stand behind him, cropped at the shoulders, wearing 90s grunge clothing like lace slips and tank tops. The background is a plain beige wall with a white curtain to the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a distressed typewriter font or a simple sans-serif in a small, metadata-like placement at the bottom corner to mimic a film date stamp.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting flat and direct?
Are the standing figures cropped at the top?
Does the color palette feel aged and warm?

postGenerationChecks: Check for harsh shadows behind subjects
Ensure skin tones look natural under flash
Verify the presence of film-like grain
Confirm the 90s DIY aesthetic is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Direct Flash + 35mm Film Grain + 90s Youth Subculture + Interior Domestic Setting
